# faraday_cohort (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "faraday_cohort" "customers" {
  name        = "customers"
  stream_name = "orders"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Human-readable label for this cohort.

### Optional

- `attributes` (Attributes List) List of attribute conditions to filter cohort membership. Only available if your account has an identity graph feature store set. Attribute conditions and trait conditions merge into one list. Required conditions (optional=false) AND together. Optional conditions (optional=true) OR together as a group. Both groups AND-ed for final membership. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--attributes))
- `explore` (Boolean, Deprecated) Deprecated. This field has no effect. Faraday keeps the value only for backward compatibility.
- `location_conditions` (Attributes List) List of atlas locations to use to spatially filter Cohort membership. A cohort may not set both `location_conditions` and `place_conditions`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--location_conditions))
- `max_count` (Number) Max count for this cohort's config
- `max_value` (Number) Max value for this cohort's config
- `min_count` (Number) Min count for this cohort's config
- `min_value` (Number) Min value for this cohort's config
- `place_conditions` (Attributes List, Deprecated) List of places to use to spatially filter Cohort membership. Superseded by `location_conditions`, which filters on the locations of an atlas. A cohort may not set both. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--place_conditions))
- `recency` (Attributes) Basing cohort on recency of event (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--recency))
- `stream_conditions` (Attributes List) List of stream properties to filter cohort membership on. The stream properties must be for the same stream set as the cohort `stream_name`. Nulls are excluded unless explicitly requested with `_null: true`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--stream_conditions))
- `stream_name` (String) The `name` field of the stream from which to build this cohort.
- `traits` (Attributes List) List of traits to filter cohort membership (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--traits))

### Read-Only

- `archived_at` (String) If not null, this resource will no longer receive updates, but will still be visable.
- `classic` (Boolean) A Managed Cohort.
- `created_at` (String) When this resource was created.
- `id` (String) A unique ID for this resource.
- `last_read_input_at` (String) The last time this resource's input was read.
- `last_updated_config_at` (String) The last time this resource's configuration was updated. If this is more recent than last_updated_output_at, the resource will be rebuilt.
- `last_updated_output_at` (String) The last time this resource successfully built.
- `metrics` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metrics))
- `population_count` (Number, Deprecated) Count of unique individuals.
- `residence_count` (Number, Deprecated) Count of unique residences.
- `resource_type` (String) The type of this resource.
- `status` (String) The current state of this resource and any updates.
- `status_changed_at` (String) When the status of this resource was last updated.
- `status_error` (String) If this resource has `status == "error"`, this will contain an error message.
- `updated_at` (String) When this resource was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--attributes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `attributes`

Required:

- `name` (String) The name of the attribute. Faraday provided attributes (associated with a feature store) must be prefixed with fig/. For example, fig/age or fig/household_income.

Optional:

- `_eq` (String) Equal to
- `_gt` (Number) Greater than
- `_gte` (Number) Greater than or equal to
- `_in` (List of String) Value is one of
- `_lt` (Number) Less than
- `_lte` (Number) Less than or equal to
- `_matches` (String) Value contains a match to the regex (re2) expression provided. For an exact regex match, use the ^ and $ characters as specified by the (re2 documentation)[https://github.com/google/re2/wiki/Syntax].
- `_nin` (List of String) Value is not one of
- `_nnull` (Boolean) Value is not null
- `_null` (Boolean) Value is null (nulls are otherwise excluded)
- `optional` (Boolean) Optional attribute conditions are unioned together, when combined they define cohorts that meet either attribute condition. At least one optional condition must be satisfied.


<a id="nestedatt--location_conditions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `location_conditions`

Optional:

- `distance` (Number) A distance in meters which will be used to expand each location's geometry. By default, the distance is set to 0, which means using the geometry itself; explicitly set your own value to override this. Points are buffered into a circle of this radius, and areas are expanded outward from their edges by this amount. See the [PostGIS documentation](https://postgis.net/docs/ST_Buffer.html) for visual descriptions of how this expansion, called buffering, works.
- `invert` (Boolean) By default, location conditions will select people who intersect a location's geometry. If `invert` is set to `true`, then instead, select people who *do not* intersect any of the locations' geometries.
- `locations` (Attributes) The atlas locations this condition selects people against. If absent, every location in the account's atlases is used. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--location_conditions--locations))

<a id="nestedatt--location_conditions--locations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `location_conditions.locations`

Optional:

- `atlas_ids` (List of String) The atlases whose locations are used to filter this cohort's membership spatially. If this is empty or absent, every atlas in the account is used.
- `location_reference_keys` (List of String) Restrict this condition to the locations carrying these reference keys. A reference key is unique only within one atlas, so these keys are matched in every atlas this condition selects. Select a single atlas to restrict them to that atlas' keys.
- `property_conditions` (Attributes List) Restrict this condition to the locations whose properties satisfy these conditions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--location_conditions--locations--property_conditions))

<a id="nestedatt--location_conditions--locations--property_conditions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `location_conditions.locations.property_conditions`

Required:

- `property` (String) The name of the location property, as defined by its atlas' `output_to_locations`, or `name` or `reference_key` to filter on the location's own name or reference key.

Optional:

- `_eq` (String) Equal to
- `_gt` (Number) Greater than
- `_gte` (Number) Greater than or equal to
- `_in` (List of String) Value is one of
- `_lt` (Number) Less than
- `_lte` (Number) Less than or equal to
- `_matches` (String) Value contains a match to the regex (re2) expression provided. For an exact regex match, use the ^ and $ characters as specified by the (re2 documentation)[https://github.com/google/re2/wiki/Syntax].
- `_neq` (String) Not equal to
- `_nin` (List of String) Value is not one of
- `_nnull` (Boolean) Value is not null
- `_null` (Boolean) Value is null (nulls are otherwise excluded)
- `optional` (Boolean) Optional property conditions are unioned together, when combined they select locations that meet either property condition. At least one optional condition must be satisfied.




<a id="nestedatt--place_conditions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `place_conditions`

Required:

- `place_id` (String) The ID of a Place which should be used to filter this Cohort's membership spatially.

Optional:

- `distance` (Number) A distance in meters which will be used to expand the Place's geometry. By default, the distance is set to 0 which means using the geometry itself, explicitly set your own value to override this. If the place is a set of addresses, then each geocoded address point will be buffered by this amount. If the place is a geometry, the entire geometry will be expanded by this amount. If the place is a GeometryCollect, each geometry will be expanded by this amount. See the [PostGIS documentation](https://postgis.net/docs/ST_Buffer.html) for visual descriptions of how this expansion, called buffering, works.
- `invert` (Boolean) By default, Place conditions will select people who intersect the place's geometry. If `invert` is set to `true`, then instead, select people who *do not* intersect the Place's geometry.


<a id="nestedatt--recency"></a>
### Nested Schema for `recency`

Required:

- `occurrence` (String) What event to pay attention to

Optional:

- `max_days` (Number) Event must have occurred no more than N days ago
- `min_days` (Number) Event must have occurred at least N days ago


<a id="nestedatt--stream_conditions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `stream_conditions`

Required:

- `property` (String) Stream property name.

Optional:

- `_eq` (String) Equal to
- `_gt` (Number) Greater than. Not allowed on `datetime` or other properties of type `date`; use `_on_or_after` instead.
- `_gte` (Number) Greater than or equal to. Not allowed on `datetime` or other properties of type `date`; use `_on_or_after` instead.
- `_in` (List of String) Value is one of
- `_lt` (Number) Less than. Not allowed on `datetime` or other properties of type `date`; use `_on_or_before` instead.
- `_lte` (Number) Less than or equal to. Not allowed on `datetime` or other properties of type `date`; use `_on_or_before` instead.
- `_matches` (String) Value contains a match to the regex (re2) expression provided. For an exact regex match, use the ^ and $ characters as specified by the (re2 documentation)[https://github.com/google/re2/wiki/Syntax].
- `_nin` (List of String) Value is not one of
- `_nnull` (Boolean) Value is not null
- `_null` (Boolean) Value is null (nulls are otherwise excluded)
- `_on_or_after` (String) On or after this day, given as `YYYY-MM-DD`. Values are compared by calendar day, ignoring time of day, so events at any time on this day match. Only for `datetime` and other properties of type `date`. Combine with `_on_or_before` for a date range, or set both to the same day to match a single day.
- `_on_or_before` (String) On or before this day, given as `YYYY-MM-DD`. Values are compared by calendar day, ignoring time of day, so events at any time on this day match. Only for `datetime` and other properties of type `date`. Combine with `_on_or_after` for a date range, or set both to the same day to match a single day.
- `optional` (Boolean) Optional stream conditions are unioned together, when combined they define cohorts that meet either stream condition. At least one optional condition must be satisfied.

- `_in` (List of String) Value is one of

- `_matches` (String) Value contains a match to the regex (re2) expression provided. For an exact regex match, use the ^ and $ characters as specified by the (re2 documentation)[https://github.com/google/re2/wiki/Syntax].
- `_nin` (List of String) Value is not one of
- `_nnull` (Boolean) Value is not null
